events.title: Chicago Business Barometer Surges Back Into Expansionary Territory In September
events.description: A report released by MNI Indicators on Wednesday showed a substantial rebound by its reading on Chicago-area business activity in the month of September. MNI Indicators said its Chicago business barometer spiked to 58.8 in September from 47.1 in August, with a reading above 50 indicating growth. Economists had expected the index to jump to 51.0.

events.title: U.S. Consumer Prices Rise 0.3% In August, Slightly Less Than Expected
events.description: The Commerce Department released a closely watched report on Wednesday showing consumer prices in the U.S. rose by slightly less than expected in the month of August. The Commerce Department said its personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index increased by 0.3 percent in August following a revised 0.1 percent uptick in July.

events.title: U.S. Private Sector Job Growth Exceeds Estimates In September
events.description: Private sector employment in the U.S. jumped by more than expected in the month of September, according to a report released by payroll processor ADP on Wednesday. ADP said private sector employment shot up by 90,000 jobs in September after rising by a downwardly revised 36,000 jobs in August. Economists had expected private sector employment to increase by 70,000 jobs.

events.title: Canadian Stocks Poised For Gains On Oil, Metals Rally
events.description: Canadian equities are expected to open higher Wednesday, supported by firmer crude oil and precious metals prices benefiting energy and materials sectors. Caution persists due to Middle East tensions and stalled U.S.-China trade negotiations.

events.title: U.S. GDP Jumps Much More Than Previously Estimated In Q2
events.description: Revised data released by the Commerce Department on Wednesday showed the U.S. economy grew by much more than previously estimated in the second quarter of 2026.

events.title: U.S. Consumer Prices Rise Slightly Less Than Expected In August
events.description: The Commerce Department released a closely watched report on Wednesday showing consumer prices in the U.S. rose by slightly less than expected in the month of August.

events.title: Conagra Brands Q1 Profit Rises, Sales Down; Confirms FY27 View; Shares Drop
events.description: Packaged foods major Conagra Brands, Inc. reported Wednesday higher first-quarter profit, despite weak sales mainly in Grocery & Snacks and Refrigerated & Frozen segments. Further, the firm maintained fiscal 2027 outlook. In the pre-market activity on the NYSE, the shares were trading 2.27 percent lower.

events.title: U.S. Private Sector Employment Jumps More Than Expected In September
events.description: Private sector employment in the U.S. jumped by more than expected in the month of September, according to a report released by payroll processor ADP on Wednesday.

events.title: Oil Surge Weighs On European Markets Despite U.K. GDP Strength
events.description: European equities turned negative Wednesday as crude oil climbed 1.8% to $97.90 per barrel amid stalled U.S.-Iran negotiations. Weak German and French data pressured regional markets, though U.K. stocks gained on stronger-than-expected GDP growth.

events.title: Positive Close For Asian Markets
events.description: Asian stock markets closed on a mostly positive note on Wednesday as the likelihood of a Fed rate hike diminished significantly. Easing bond yields as well as the momentum in tech stocks also bolstered sentiment. However, lingering anxiety ahead of updates to inflation and labor market due from the U.S. on Wednesday morning limited gains.

events.title: Oil Prices, FPI Outflows Trigger Sharp Selloff In Indian Markets
events.description: India's key stock indices Sensex and Nifty50 closed lower Wednesday despite early strength, pressured by elevated oil prices and foreign portfolio investor selling in final trading hour. Brent crude climbed to $97.70/barrel.

events.title: FTSE 100 Edges Higher As Revised GDP Shows Stronger Q2 Growth
events.description: U.K. stocks gained ground Wednesday after the Office for National Statistics revised Q2 GDP growth upward to 0.5% from 0.4%. The FTSE 100 rose 0.15% to 10,652.70, though oil price gains amid Middle East uncertainty limited broader momentum.

events.title: Higher Crude Oil Prices, Weak Economic Data Weigh On French Stocks
events.description:
The French stock market's benchmark index CAC 40 slipped into negative territory on Wednesday, as oil prices climbed higher on supply concerns amid lingering uncertainty about Iran and U.S. reaching a deal to end their conflict anytime soon. 

Data showing an acceleration in French inflation in the month of September weighed as well on sentiment.
